content.text: READY (headless) — Aseprite 1.3.18.6-dev, no sprite open. Nothing is on disk until you save.

structuredContent.directive: Ready, headless: there is no window, so the user sees only what `look` shows and the files you write. Open or create a sprite with sprite_manage, and save it (op 'save'/'save_as') before you finish — unsaved work is lost when this server stops.
